contract.candidate_universe: items of the fitted training window
contract.seen_item_policy: items in the caller's seen pairs are never recommended
contract.cold_start: users or items without factors get no recommendations and no rating prediction (null)
contract.ranking_score: dot(user factors, item factors), exact over the whole catalog; ties by ascending item_index
contract.rating_prediction: dot(user factors, item factors), unclipped; explicit feedback, nonnegative=False
